## Metadata cleaning

This script cleans the metadata, creating multiple tables for building the database

```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# clean_metadata.R - Clean the supporting files and write normalised, database-ready tables.
#
# Run AFTER data_cleaning.R (it needs cleaned_data.csv for the gene and parameter tables).
# Usage: Rscript clean_metadata.R            (file names below can be edited)
#
# Inputs (same folder):
#   cleaned_data.csv                  - output of data_cleaning.R
#   IMPC_parameter_description.txt    - parameters (one row per impcParameterOrigId)
#   IMPC_procedure.txt                - procedure of each impcParameterOrigId
#   Disease_information.txt           - MGI report: human gene - DO disease - mouse gene
#   bespokeTask_hml.txt               - BioMart homology export (bespoke task)
#   group10_query_genes.csv           - the collaborator's genes of interest
#
# Outputs (folder db_tables/), one CSV per database table:
#   procedure.csv            procedure_id, procedure_name, description, is_mandatory
#   parameter.csv            parameter_id, parameter_name, procedure_id, procedure_source, in_impc_catalogue
#   parameter_variant.csv    impc_parameter_orig_id, parameter_id, name, description
#   parameter_group.csv      group_id, group_name, rule
#   parameter_group_map.csv  parameter_id, group_id
#   gene.csv                 mgi_id, gene_symbol, in_impc_data
#   disease.csv              doid, disease_name
#   human_gene.csv           hgnc_id, human_symbol, human_name, mgi_id
#   gene_disease.csv         gene_disease_id, mgi_id, doid
#   disease_model_genotype.csv  gene_disease_id, genotype_id
#   species.csv              species_id, common_name, scientific_name, ensembl_prefix
#   ensembl_gene.csv         ensembl_gene_id, species_id, gene_name, mgi_id
#   homology.csv             mouse_ensembl_id, homolog_ensembl_id, homology_type,
#                            percent_identity, last_common_ancestor
#   query_gene.csv           gene_symbol, mgi_id, n_analyses
# plus db_tables/metadata_cleaning_log.csv describing every step.
#
# Base R only.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
f_clean     <- "cleaned_data.csv"
f_parameter <- "IMPC_parameter_description.txt"
f_procedure <- "IMPC_procedure.txt"
f_disease   <- NULL   # found automatically below

f_homology  <- "bespokeTask_hml.txt"
f_query     <- NULL   # found automatically below
out_dir     <- "db_tables"

# files that were downloaded twice get names like "Disease_information (1).txt"
find_file <- function(pattern) {
  hits <- list.files(".", pattern = pattern)
  if (!length(hits)) stop("No file matching ", pattern, " in ", getwd())
  if (length(hits) > 1) message("Several files match ", pattern, " - using ", hits[length(hits)])
  hits[length(hits)]
}
if (is.null(f_disease)) f_disease <- find_file("^Disease_information.*\\.txt$")
if (is.null(f_query))   f_query   <- find_file("^group10_query_genes.*\\.csv$")

for (f in c(f_clean, f_parameter, f_procedure, f_disease, f_homology, f_query))
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("File not found: ", f, " - check the name at the top of this script")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

change_log <- data.frame(file = character(), step = character(), rows = integer(),
                         detail = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
log_step <- function(file, step, n, detail) {
  change_log[nrow(change_log) + 1, ] <<- list(file, step, as.integer(n), detail)
  message(sprintf("[%-10s] %-14s %7d  %s", file, step, as.integer(n), detail))
}

# trim every column and turn blank strings into NA
tidy <- function(df, file) {
  for (col in names(df)) {
    x <- trimws(df[[col]])
    n_ws <- sum(!is.na(x) & x != df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    blank <- !is.na(x) & x %in% c("", "NA")
    x[blank] <- NA
    if (n_ws)       log_step(file, "whitespace", n_ws, paste0(col, ": leading/trailing spaces removed"))
    if (any(blank)) log_step(file, "missing", sum(blank), paste0(col, ": blank -> NA"))
    df[[col]] <- x
  }
  df
}

mode_of <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_character_)
  tab <- table(x)
  names(tab)[which.max(tab)]
}

write_table <- function(df, name) {
  path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv"))
  write.csv(df, path, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  log_step(name, "written", nrow(df), path)
}

check_pk <- function(df, cols, name) {
  d <- sum(duplicated(df[cols]))
  if (d) stop(sprintf("Primary key violated in %s (%s): %d duplicates", name, paste(cols, collapse = ","), d))
}

clean <- read.csv(f_clean, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "NA", check.names = FALSE)

# ===========================================================================
# 1. PROCEDURES and PARAMETERS
# ===========================================================================
par  <- read.csv(f_parameter, colClasses = "character", strip.white = TRUE, na.strings = character(0))
proc <- read.csv(f_procedure, colClasses = "character", strip.white = TRUE, na.strings = character(0))
par  <- tidy(par,  "parameter")
proc <- tidy(proc, "procedure")

# exact duplicate rows in the parameter file
d <- duplicated(par)
if (any(d)) { par <- par[!d, ]; log_step("parameter", "duplicates", sum(d), "exact duplicate rows removed") }
if (anyDuplicated(par$impcParameterOrigId)) stop("impcParameterOrigId is not unique after de-duplication")
if (anyDuplicated(proc$impcParameterOrigId)) stop("impcParameterOrigId is not unique in the procedure file")
bad_id <- !grepl("^[A-Z]+_[A-Z0-9]+_[0-9]{3}_[0-9]{3}$", par$parameterId)
if (any(bad_id)) log_step("parameter", "check", sum(bad_id), "parameterId not in SOP format")

orphans <- setdiff(proc$impcParameterOrigId, par$impcParameterOrigId)
if (length(orphans)) log_step("procedure", "check", length(orphans), "OrigIds with no parameter row")

## 1a procedure table: the 51 procedures were repeated once per parameter (5,311 rows)
# isMandatory is TRUE/FALSE text -> logical. Where one procedure had several
# descriptions, the longest real one is kept; snake_case placeholders
# ('experimental_design') are not real descriptions.
proc$isMandatory <- toupper(proc$isMandatory)
if (any(!proc$isMandatory %in% c("TRUE", "FALSE")))
  stop("isMandatory has values other than TRUE/FALSE")
placeholder <- !is.na(proc$description) & grepl("^[a-z0-9_]+$", proc$description)
if (any(placeholder)) log_step("procedure", "placeholder", sum(placeholder),
                               "snake_case placeholder descriptions -> NA")
proc$description[placeholder] <- NA

proc_names <- sort(unique(proc$name))
pick_desc  <- function(x) { x <- unique(x[!is.na(x)]); if (!length(x)) NA_character_ else x[which.max(nchar(x))] }
n_desc     <- tapply(proc$description, proc$name, function(x) length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])))
if (any(n_desc > 1)) log_step("procedure", "conflict", sum(n_desc > 1),
                              paste("procedures with >1 description, longest kept:",
                                    paste(names(n_desc)[n_desc > 1], collapse = "; ")))
mand <- tapply(proc$isMandatory, proc$name, function(x) length(unique(x)))
if (any(mand > 1)) stop("A procedure is both mandatory and optional")

procedure <- data.frame(
  procedure_id   = seq_along(proc_names),
  procedure_name = proc_names,
  description    = unname(tapply(proc$description, proc$name, pick_desc)[proc_names]),
  is_mandatory   = unname(tapply(proc$isMandatory, proc$name, `[`, 1)[proc_names]) == "TRUE",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
log_step("procedure", "normalised", nrow(proc),
         sprintf("%d rows reduced to %d unique procedures", nrow(proc), nrow(procedure)))

## 1b parameter_variant: every row of the parameter file is kept (all data stored)
pv <- merge(par, proc[c("impcParameterOrigId", "name")], by = "impcParameterOrigId",
            all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c("", "_procedure"))
parameter_variant <- data.frame(
  impc_parameter_orig_id = as.integer(pv$impcParameterOrigId),
  parameter_id           = pv$parameterId,
  name                   = pv$name,
  description            = pv$description,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
parameter_variant <- parameter_variant[order(parameter_variant$impc_parameter_orig_id), ]

## 1c parameter: ONE row per parameter_id - the key used by the analysis data
# Catalogue parameters (in the parameter file) get their procedure from the file.
# Parameters only seen in the analysis data (other centres' IDs, e.g. JAX_OFD_009_001)
# get a procedure only when their 3-letter code belongs to exactly one IMPC procedure.
cat_proc <- tapply(pv$name_procedure, pv$parameterId, mode_of)
cat_name <- tapply(pv$name, pv$parameterId, mode_of)
n_names  <- tapply(pv$name, pv$parameterId, function(x) length(unique(x)))
if (any(n_names > 1)) log_step("parameter", "conflict", sum(n_names > 1),
                               "parameter_ids with >1 name across versions; most common kept (all kept in parameter_variant)")

data_par  <- unique(clean[!is.na(clean$parameter_id), c("parameter_id", "parameter_name")])
data_name <- tapply(data_par$parameter_name, data_par$parameter_id, mode_of)

all_ids <- sort(union(names(cat_name), names(data_name)))
parameter <- data.frame(parameter_id = all_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# name: as measured in the analysis data when present, otherwise the catalogue name
parameter$parameter_name    <- ifelse(all_ids %in% names(data_name),
                                      unname(data_name[all_ids]), unname(cat_name[all_ids]))
parameter$in_impc_catalogue <- all_ids %in% names(cat_name)

code       <- sapply(strsplit(names(cat_proc), "_"), `[`, 2)
code_procs <- tapply(cat_proc, code, function(x) unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
code_map   <- unlist(code_procs[sapply(code_procs, length) == 1])
my_code    <- sapply(strsplit(all_ids, "_"), `[`, 2)

proc_name <- ifelse(parameter$in_impc_catalogue, unname(cat_proc[all_ids]), NA)
parameter$procedure_source <- ifelse(!is.na(proc_name), "catalogue", NA)
infer <- is.na(proc_name) & my_code %in% names(code_map)
proc_name[infer] <- unname(code_map[my_code[infer]])
parameter$procedure_source[infer] <- "inferred_from_id_code"
parameter$procedure_id <- procedure$procedure_id[match(proc_name, procedure$procedure_name)]
parameter <- parameter[c("parameter_id", "parameter_name", "procedure_id",
                         "procedure_source", "in_impc_catalogue")]

log_step("parameter", "normalised", nrow(parameter),
         sprintf("%d catalogue + %d analysis-only parameters; procedure from catalogue %d, inferred %d, unknown %d",
                 sum(parameter$in_impc_catalogue), sum(!parameter$in_impc_catalogue),
                 sum(parameter$procedure_source == "catalogue", na.rm = TRUE), sum(infer),
                 sum(is.na(parameter$procedure_id))))
missing_par <- setdiff(unique(clean$parameter_id[!is.na(clean$parameter_id)]), parameter$parameter_id)
if (length(missing_par)) stop("Analysis parameter_ids missing from parameter table")

## 1d parameter groups (brief: weight, images, brain + at least 3 more)
# A parameter can belong to several groups (Brain weight -> weight AND brain),
# so groups are a many-to-many link table. Membership = name pattern OR procedure.
groups <- list(
  list("weight",          "name contains 'weight'", "weight", character(0)),
  list("images",          "name contains 'image'/'imaging'", "imag", character(0)),
  list("brain",           "name contains 'brain' (fore/mid/hind-brain, brainstem)", "brain", character(0)),
  list("blood",           "haematology / clinical chemistry / insulin procedures, or blood terms",
       "blood|plasma|serum|haemoglobin|hemoglobin|platelet|erythrocyte|leukocyte",
       c("Hematology", "Clinical Chemistry", "Insulin Blood Level")),
  list("eye",             "Eye Morphology procedure or eye structures",
       "\\beye|retina|lens\\b|cornea|iris|pupil|ophthalmo|vitreous|conjunctiva",
       c("Eye Morphology")),
  list("cardiovascular",  "ECG, echocardiography, heart weight procedures or heart terms",
       "heart|cardiac|cardio|ventric|atri(um|al)|aort|ecg|\\bqrs|\\bhr\\b",
       c("Electrocardiogram (ECG)", "Echo", "Heart Weight")),
  list("skeleton",        "X-ray / DEXA procedures or bone terms",
       "bone|skull|vertebra|\\bribs?\\b|tibia|femur|digit|\\blimb|\\bbmd\\b|\\bbmc\\b",
       c("X-ray", "Body Composition (DEXA lean/fat)")),
  list("behaviour",       "behavioural / neurological test procedures",
       "startle|pre-pulse|locomot|freezing|anxiety|grip strength",
       c("Open Field", "Light-Dark Test", "Y-maze", "Fear Conditioning",
         "Acoustic Startle and Pre-pulse Inhibition (PPI)", "Grip Strength")),
  list("hearing",         "Auditory Brain Stem Response procedure or ABR terms",
       "\\babr\\b|auditory|hearing", c("Auditory Brain Stem Response")),
  list("metabolism",      "glucose tolerance, calorimetry, body composition or metabolic terms",
       "glucose|insulin|calori|energy expenditure|respiratory exchange|oxygen consumption|fat mass|lean mass",
       c("Intraperitoneal glucose tolerance test (IPGTT)", "Indirect Calorimetry")),
  list("immune",          "Immunophenotyping procedure or immune cell terms",
       "\\bcd[0-9]|t cell|b cell|nk cell|monocyte|neutrophil|lymphocyte|macrophage|dendritic",
       c("Immunophenotyping")),
  list("embryo",          "embryo / placenta / viability procedures (E9.5-E18.5)",
       "embryo|placenta",
       grep("Embryo|Placenta|Viability E|MicroCT|OPT E9.5", procedure$procedure_name, value = TRUE))
)
parameter_group <- data.frame(group_id = seq_along(groups),
                              group_name = sapply(groups, `[[`, 1),
                              rule = sapply(groups, `[[`, 2), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
p_proc <- procedure$procedure_name[match(parameter$procedure_id, procedure$procedure_id)]
map_rows <- lapply(seq_along(groups), function(i) {
  g   <- groups[[i]]
  hit <- grepl(g[[3]], parameter$parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE) |
    (!is.na(p_proc) & p_proc %in% g[[4]])
  if (!sum(hit)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(parameter_id = parameter$parameter_id[hit], group_id = i, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
parameter_group_map <- do.call(rbind, map_rows)
counts <- table(factor(parameter_group_map$group_id, levels = parameter_group$group_id))
parameter_group$n_parameters <- as.integer(counts)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(parameter_group)))
  log_step("param_group", parameter_group$group_name[i], parameter_group$n_parameters[i], parameter_group$rule[i])

# ===========================================================================
# 2. DISEASE INFORMATION (MGI report, no header, '#' comment lines)
# ===========================================================================
if (!startsWith(readLines(f_disease, n = 1), "#"))
  stop(f_disease, " is the OLD disease file - use the 2026 MGI report (starts with '#' comment lines)")
dis <- read.delim(f_disease, header = FALSE, comment.char = "#", quote = "",
                  colClasses = "character", na.strings = character(0))
if (ncol(dis) != 8) stop("Disease file: expected 8 columns, found ", ncol(dis))
names(dis) <- c("human_symbol", "human_name", "hgnc_id", "disease_name", "doid",
                "genotype_ids", "mouse_symbol", "mgi_id")
dis <- tidy(dis, "disease")
d <- duplicated(dis)
if (any(d)) { dis <- dis[!d, ]; log_step("disease", "duplicates", sum(d), "exact duplicate rows removed") }

for (chk in list(c("doid", "^DOID:[0-9]+$"), c("hgnc_id", "^HGNC:[0-9]+$"), c("mgi_id", "^MGI:[0-9]+$"))) {
  bad <- !is.na(dis[[chk[1]]]) & !grepl(chk[2], dis[[chk[1]]])
  if (any(bad)) { dis <- dis[!bad, ]; log_step("disease", "invalid ID", sum(bad), paste(chk[1], "bad format - row removed")) }
}

disease <- unique(dis[c("doid", "disease_name")])
if (anyDuplicated(disease$doid)) stop("A DOID has more than one name")
disease <- disease[order(disease$doid), ]

human_gene <- unique(dis[c("hgnc_id", "human_symbol", "human_name", "mgi_id")])
check_pk(human_gene, "hgnc_id", "human_gene")

pairs <- unique(dis[c("mgi_id", "doid")])
pairs <- pairs[order(pairs$mgi_id, pairs$doid), ]
gene_disease <- data.frame(gene_disease_id = seq_len(nrow(pairs)), pairs, row.names = NULL)

# genotype IDs: pipe-separated list in ONE cell -> one row each (first normal form)
has_g <- !is.na(dis$genotype_ids)
gl    <- strsplit(dis$genotype_ids[has_g], "|", fixed = TRUE)
geno  <- data.frame(mgi_id = rep(dis$mgi_id[has_g], lengths(gl)),
                    doid   = rep(dis$doid[has_g], lengths(gl)),
                    genotype_id = trimws(unlist(gl)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
geno  <- geno[grepl("^MGI:[0-9]+$", geno$genotype_id), ]
geno$gene_disease_id <- gene_disease$gene_disease_id[match(paste(geno$mgi_id, geno$doid),
                                                           paste(gene_disease$mgi_id, gene_disease$doid))]
disease_model_genotype <- unique(geno[c("gene_disease_id", "genotype_id")])
log_step("disease", "1NF split", nrow(disease_model_genotype),
         sprintf("pipe-separated genotype lists in %d rows split into one row per genotype", sum(has_g)))
log_step("disease", "normalised", nrow(dis),
         sprintf("%d diseases, %d human genes, %d gene-disease links", nrow(disease), nrow(human_gene), nrow(gene_disease)))

# ===========================================================================
# 3. GENE table (mouse genes keyed by MGI ID)
# ===========================================================================
g1 <- unique(clean[!is.na(clean$gene_accession_id), c("gene_accession_id", "gene_symbol")])
names(g1) <- c("mgi_id", "gene_symbol")
g2 <- unique(dis[c("mgi_id", "mouse_symbol")]); names(g2) <- c("mgi_id", "gene_symbol")
gene <- rbind(g1, g2[!g2$mgi_id %in% g1$mgi_id, ])
both <- merge(g1, g2, by = "mgi_id")
diff_sym <- both$gene_symbol.x != both$gene_symbol.y
if (any(diff_sym)) log_step("gene", "conflict", sum(diff_sym), "symbol differs between IMPC data and MGI report (IMPC kept)")
gene$in_impc_data <- gene$mgi_id %in% g1$mgi_id
gene <- gene[order(gene$mgi_id), ]
check_pk(gene, "mgi_id", "gene")
log_step("gene", "normalised", nrow(gene),
         sprintf("%d genes in IMPC data + %d disease-only genes", sum(gene$in_impc_data), sum(!gene$in_impc_data)))

# ===========================================================================
# 4. BESPOKE TASK: HOMOLOGY (BioMart export)
# ===========================================================================
hom <- read.delim(f_homology, quote = "", colClasses = "character",
                  na.strings = character(0), check.names = FALSE)
if (ncol(hom) != 12) stop("Homology file: expected 12 columns, found ", ncol(hom))
names(hom) <- c("mouse_id", "h_id", "h_name", "h_lca", "h_type", "h_pid",
                "mouse_name", "m_id", "m_name", "m_lca", "m_type", "m_pid")
n_raw <- nrow(hom)
hom <- tidy(hom, "homology")

bad <- !grepl("^ENSMUSG[0-9]{11}$", hom$mouse_id)
if (any(bad)) { hom <- hom[!bad, ]; log_step("homology", "invalid ID", sum(bad), "mouse Ensembl ID missing/invalid - row removed") }
for (chk in list(c("h_id", "^ENSG[0-9]{11}$"), c("m_id", "^ENSMMUG[0-9]{11}$"))) {
  bad <- !is.na(hom[[chk[1]]]) & !grepl(chk[2], hom[[chk[1]]])
  if (any(bad)) { hom[[chk[1]]][bad] <- NA; log_step("homology", "invalid ID", sum(bad), paste(chk[1], "bad format -> NA")) }
}

# Instructions: keep a mouse gene only if it has a mouse Ensembl ID AND >= 1 homology match
no_match <- is.na(hom$h_id) & is.na(hom$m_id)
log_step("homology", "filter", sum(no_match),
         "rows with no human or macaque homolog removed (bespoke instructions)")
hom <- hom[!no_match, ]

# The export is a cross product: every human match x every macaque match of a gene.
# Splitting by species and removing duplicates stores each relationship once.
split_species <- function(id, name, lca, type, pid) {
  x <- unique(data.frame(mouse_ensembl_id = hom$mouse_id, homolog_ensembl_id = hom[[id]],
                         homolog_name = hom[[name]], homology_type = hom[[type]],
                         percent_identity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(hom[[pid]])),
                         last_common_ancestor = hom[[lca]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  x[!is.na(x$homolog_ensembl_id), ]
}
hh <- split_species("h_id", "h_name", "h_lca", "h_type", "h_pid")
mm <- split_species("m_id", "m_name", "m_lca", "m_type", "m_pid")
log_step("homology", "normalised", n_raw,
         sprintf("cross-product export split into %d mouse-human and %d mouse-macaque pairs", nrow(hh), nrow(mm)))

bad_pid <- (!is.na(hh$percent_identity) & (hh$percent_identity < 0 | hh$percent_identity > 100))
if (any(bad_pid)) stop("Human % identity outside 0-100")
zero <- !is.na(mm$percent_identity) & mm$percent_identity == 0
if (any(zero)) log_step("homology", "flag", sum(zero), "macaque matches with 0% identity kept (reported by Ensembl)")
ok_types <- c("ortholog_one2one", "ortholog_one2many", "ortholog_many2many")
if (any(!c(hh$homology_type, mm$homology_type) %in% ok_types)) stop("Unexpected homology type")

species <- data.frame(species_id = 1:3,
                      common_name = c("mouse", "human", "macaque"),
                      scientific_name = c("Mus musculus", "Homo sapiens", "Macaca mulatta"),
                      ensembl_prefix = c("ENSMUSG", "ENSG", "ENSMMUG"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# mouse genes: symbol -> MGI ID only where the symbol is unambiguous
mouse <- unique(hom[c("mouse_id", "mouse_name")])
if (anyDuplicated(mouse$mouse_id)) stop("A mouse Ensembl ID has more than one name")
amb <- unique(mouse$mouse_name[duplicated(mouse$mouse_name) & !is.na(mouse$mouse_name)])
if (length(amb)) log_step("homology", "ambiguous", length(amb),
                          "gene symbols shared by >1 mouse Ensembl ID - not linked to MGI")
mgi_by_symbol <- setNames(gene$mgi_id, gene$gene_symbol)
mgi_by_symbol <- mgi_by_symbol[!duplicated(names(mgi_by_symbol))]
mouse_mgi <- ifelse(is.na(mouse$mouse_name) | mouse$mouse_name %in% amb, NA,
                    unname(mgi_by_symbol[mouse$mouse_name]))
log_step("homology", "link", sum(!is.na(mouse_mgi)),
         sprintf("of %d mouse Ensembl genes linked to an MGI ID by symbol (%d of them in the IMPC data)",
                 nrow(mouse), sum(mouse_mgi %in% gene$mgi_id[gene$in_impc_data])))

hum_genes <- unique(hh[c("homolog_ensembl_id", "homolog_name")])
mac_genes <- unique(mm[c("homolog_ensembl_id", "homolog_name")])
fix_names <- function(x) {                                   # one name per ID
  nm <- tapply(x$homolog_name, x$homolog_ensembl_id, mode_of)
  data.frame(id = names(nm), name = unname(nm), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
hum_genes <- fix_names(hum_genes); mac_genes <- fix_names(mac_genes)
ensembl_gene <- rbind(
  data.frame(ensembl_gene_id = mouse$mouse_id, species_id = 1L, gene_name = mouse$mouse_name,
             mgi_id = mouse_mgi, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(ensembl_gene_id = hum_genes$id, species_id = 2L, gene_name = hum_genes$name,
             mgi_id = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(ensembl_gene_id = mac_genes$id, species_id = 3L, gene_name = mac_genes$name,
             mgi_id = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
check_pk(ensembl_gene, "ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_gene")

homology <- rbind(hh, mm)[c("mouse_ensembl_id", "homolog_ensembl_id", "homology_type",
                            "percent_identity", "last_common_ancestor")]
check_pk(homology, c("mouse_ensembl_id", "homolog_ensembl_id"), "homology")
log_step("homology", "summary", nrow(homology),
         sprintf("homology rows for %d mouse genes (%d human, %d macaque genes)",
                 nrow(mouse), nrow(hum_genes), nrow(mac_genes)))

# ===========================================================================
# 5. QUERY GENES (no header, trailing blank line)
# ===========================================================================
q <- trimws(readLines(f_query, warn = FALSE))
q <- unique(q[nzchar(q)])
query_gene <- data.frame(gene_symbol = q,
                         mgi_id = gene$mgi_id[match(q, gene$gene_symbol)],
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
query_gene$n_analyses <- vapply(query_gene$mgi_id, function(m)
  sum(clean$gene_accession_id == m, na.rm = TRUE), integer(1))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(query_gene)))
  log_step("query", query_gene$gene_symbol[i], query_gene$n_analyses[i],
           paste("analyses; MGI ID", query_gene$mgi_id[i]))

# ===========================================================================
# Write
# ===========================================================================
write_table(procedure, "procedure")
write_table(parameter, "parameter")
write_table(parameter_variant, "parameter_variant")
write_table(parameter_group, "parameter_group")
write_table(parameter_group_map, "parameter_group_map")
write_table(gene, "gene")
write_table(disease, "disease")
write_table(human_gene, "human_gene")
write_table(gene_disease, "gene_disease")
write_table(disease_model_genotype, "disease_model_genotype")
write_table(species, "species")
write_table(ensembl_gene, "ensembl_gene")
write_table(homology, "homology")
write_table(query_gene, "query_gene")
write.csv(change_log, "metadata_cleaning_log.csv", row.names = FALSE)
message("\nDone - ", nrow(change_log), " log entries in metadata_cleaning_log.csv")
```
